title: Cici's P城大逃杀
description:
活到最后！水塔下有一个坦克，每30秒刷新出一个。
坦克每秒回复3 HP，自带秒杀炮，并且可以双持拾取的武器进行双发射击。
Be the last survivor! A tank spawns under the water tower every 30 seconds.
The tank regenerates 3 HP per second, comes equipped with a one-shot cannon, and can dual-wield picked-up weapons to fire both at once.
